lines: New game icons: the 7 Oath skills and Sentence of Exposure, Girdle of the Turning Earth and The Heartwood Girdle; Wool Shoes and Chapel Shoes have their icon again.
Woeweaver now also raises the skill's bleeds (game log). Woe of Sundering no longer raises bleeds in the sim: the log showed it does not.

Skill tree: right-click a taken node to keep it, so Optimize tree never refunds it. Right-click an untaken node twice to mark it must take: Optimize and Plan route to it first. On a phone, use the Keep button in the node panel.

8 Oaths the game offers were missing from the Oath panel and the sim: Long Fight and Crushing Blow (Fury), Shepherd and Grave Choir (Legion), High Sun and Dawn Guard (Dawn), Hidden Wire (Snare) and Settled Blade (Stillness). Taken from in-game tooltips; a character with Long Fight sworn now shows the right maximum life.

Guardians: only the strongest plain "takes more damage" counts, but typed lines (Woe of Sundering's more Physical damage, Sentence of Rot's more damage from Bleed, Poison and Ignite) now multiply on top, as the game log shows.
Woe of Sundering now also makes bleeds bigger in the sim (the bleed is laid from the bigger hit; suggested by the game log, not proven).
FAQ: Curses & Marks explains what stacks on a Guardian.

Patch 79 rules in the damage sim: links (each empty support socket costs damage from gem level 9), support slots 5 and 6 need the skill's attribute, the new ailment rules (Kindle, Deep Wound, Crack, Static Build, chill), and added damage supports on attacks growing at the attack rate.

New Patch 79 skills and supports count where they matter on one enemy (Woeweaver, Haemorrhage, Lone Herald, Quarry Command, the companions' damage bonus), and Dragon Hearts are on the Dragonling tree.
Dragonling Ascendancies now count on Guardians (Mountain's Weight, Hunter's Mark, Moonlit Stance, Aftershock, Far Shot, Point Blank and more), as the game runs them: without their old downsides.
Sentence of Rot now raises poison, bleed and ignite damage in the sim (it did nothing before).
Oath seats: an Oath counts only while its seat on the tree is taken, as in the game since Patch 79.
More item lines count: Thousand Feathers, Cooldown Recovery, Vow and Herald effect, Veinwrit Grips and others.

Ladder: Rupture Level spread, most taken keystones and Ascendancies, and a hero's best clear time. Item Search shows forged ranges on uniques. FAQ: a new Drop Chances page. Gear tools: a resistance penalty setting.
Summary strip: Life and Mana now share one cell, Life in red over Mana in blue. Mana is new there (maximum mana, rounded like the game).
Skill tree: the shared areas between two classes say which ones ("Between Mage and Necromancer") instead of "Seam_60".
Negative lines read the game's way: "3% reduced Mana Cost", "10% less Damage", "-6% to maximum Fire Resistance" (tree, items and patch history).
Unbroken Wall reads "while holding a Shield", and the Focus keystone no longer shows "Focus Main" / "Focus Other" lines.

Item Search: Oathword lines that showed raw game data (Earthbreaker, Pyre of Kings, Petalfall, Clarion and the secret Oathwords) now read in the game's own words; the secret Oathwords say "At any item level" instead of "Below item level ?".
Item lines no longer repeat a condition in brackets, like "while holding a Shield (HoldingShield)".
Patch history: skill and Vow texts show their numbers instead of blanks like {BrandChains}, and trigger lines read as plain text.
Ladder: patch 79 shows real damage numbers again, so the note about patch 78's smaller scale past Rupture 100 is gone for heroes measured on the new patch.

Bleeding: the bleed on an enemy is now the strongest one rolled during a bleed's life, as in the game (checked against the game log), not one from the average hit. Skills that roll many bleeds show more bleed damage; the Bleeding panel shows how many are rolled.
Recent Patch: new passive nodes now sit in one dropdown that opens on a click, so a big tree patch no longer makes the page scroll on and on.
Focused Volley: every arrow now rolls its own bleed and poison, as in the game (checked against the game log). Bleed lasts longer and more poison stacks build up.
Oathwords: power lines on a two-handed weapon now count once, as in the game (they counted twice). Bladesong and other two-handed Oathwords show and deal less.
Items: a Vow that gives skill levels now says it counts half, and its share shows the real amount.
Translations: Oathword names now use the game's own words in every page language (Bladesong is 刃之歌 in Chinese).
Ladder: the note on heroes past Rupture 100 (the game now shows their damage on a smaller scale) now shows for the patch that is live.

Ready for Patch 78 (switches on once the game's public data reaches build 78): minions take half of your "more damage per 1,000 Armour / Life / Energy Shield" lines, and the passive tree's and Dragonling's "physical as extra" element lines (Venomcraft, Poison Aspect, Sanctified and others) reach your minions.

Ladder: shows the Riven Tier next to Rupture 200 once the game's public data lists it. Heroes past Rupture 100 get a note that the game now shows their damage on a smaller scale, so it does not compare with the sim.

Loading a save now reads the potions on your belt into the Brewery, and the damage counts them. Load your saves again to get them. Change anything in the Brewery to keep your own belt; a button there brings the save's potions back.

Configure Enemy: new "Enable your Brewmaw potions" switch (on by default) to leave potions out of every damage number and optimizer. The "Penetration can push resistance below 0%" switch is gone; the sim keeps that rule.
Brewery: "more Damage for every 1,000 Energy Shield / Life / Armour / Evasion" potion lines now show as damage (the sim already counted them).
